answer_1.quote: In zero-shot extractive summarization, we train an extractive model (based on a pre-trained multilingual transformer) on English summarization dataset, which selects important sentences in English documents. Then, we apply this trained model to documents of a different language (i.e., extracting sentences of documents in another language).

answer_2.quote: Following , we report the F1 ROUGE-L score of NLSSum with a full Python implemented ROUGE metric , which calculates the overlap lexical units between extracted sentences and ground-truth.
